results.rationale: Consistency: Excluding both temple arms, the lens outlines, nose pads, tabletop grain, lighting and framing remain consistent; the small bridge area between the lenses has a slightly different dark connection. Instruction: The blunt lower arm is extended leftward to a rounded tip. A complete, smoothly continuous temple was expected; the extension fulfills the core request, but a conspicuous notch remains at its join. Quality: Structure, perspective, lighting and tabletop texture are coherent; the small discontinuity in the lower temple is the one visible imperfection.

Consistency: Beyond permitted pest damage, the leaf cluster is substantially replaced: leaf shapes and arrangement, branch orientation, framing, backlighting and the bright circular background highlights all change. Instruction: Several irregular holes and small brown damaged patches appear. The expected result is the original leaves with pest damage; holes realize the main idea, but the original cluster is replaced instead of simply damaged. Knowledge: The supplied explanation predicts insect-eaten holes, and the visible missing leaf tissue with irregular browned margins fully matches that biological outcome. Quality: Structure ✔, naturalness ✔, artifact-free ✔, texture fidelity ✔; the overlapping leaves, veins, irregular damage and soft dark background form a coherent image.
